title: agropyron panormitanum subsp. hispanicum
intro: Agropyron panormitanum subsp. hispanicum, commonly known as hispanic false brome, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its sedative effects, promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of hispanic false brome include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of this plant are primarily attributed to its calming effects, which can help alleviate stress-related disorders and promote overall well-being.
